introduction: Als Papiertechnologe (m/w/d) bist du ein gefragter Spezialist. In einem Team aus qualifizierten Fachleuten stellst du in Produktionsanlagen Papier, Karton und Pappe her und bereitest sie für die jeweilige Weiterverarbeitung vor. Du richtest Produktionsanlagen von gigantischen Ausmaßen ein, steuerst, wartest und überwachst sie.
tasks:
• Während der Ausbildung kann die Fachhochschulreife erlangt werden
  • Meister (m/w/d) – Industriemeister (m/w/d) Papiererzeugung
  • Techniker (m/w/d) – Papiertechnik
  • Technischer Fachwirt (m/w/d)
  • Hochschulbildungsgang: Bachelor / Master of Engineering Papiertechnik
profile:
• Mindestens guter Abschluss der Berufsreife
  • Interesse an Mathematik, Physik und Chemie
  • Interesse am Umgang mit komplexen technischen Anlagen
  • Teamfähigkeit
closingText: Während der dreijährigen Ausbildungszeit findet dreimal jährlich Blockunterricht von drei bis sechs Wochen im Papierzentrum in Gernsbach (Schwarzwald) statt. Während der Berufsschulzeit werden die Kosten für Unterkunft, Verpflegung und An-/Abreise übernommen,

company.description2:
WEIG is a renowned family-owned business group in the international paper and cartonboard industry. Across its locations in Europe and South America, the Group employs around 2,050 people and generates annual turnover of approximately 615 million euros.

Its business model is based on the circular economy and combines recovered paper recycling, the production of paper and cartonboard, and the further processing and marketing of products such as folding cartons and plasterboard. Recovered paper serves as a key raw material for the production of new paper-based products. By using recycled fibers and closely integrating the individual stages of the value chain, WEIG makes a tangible contribution to resource conservation. Through close dialogue with its customers, the Group continuously and systematically develops its products and applications.

introduction: As a paper technologist (m/f/d), you are a sought-after specialist. As part of a team of qualified experts, you manufacture paper, cardboard, and paperboard in production facilities and prepare them for further processing. You set up, control, maintain, and monitor production facilities of enormous proportions.
tasks:
• During the training program, participants can obtain a technical college entrance qualification.
  • Master craftsman (m/f/d)
  • Industrial master craftsman (m/f/d) in paper production Technician (m/f/d)
  • Paper technology Technical business administrator (m/f/d)
  • University degree program: Bachelor's/Master's degree in paper technology engineering
profile:
• At least a good vocational qualification
  • Interest in mathematics, physics, and chemistry
  • Interest in working with complex technical systems
  • Ability to work in a team
closingText: During the three-year training period, block instruction lasting three to six weeks takes place three times a year at the Paper Center in Gernsbach (Black Forest). During vocational school, the costs for accommodation, meals, and travel to and from the school are covered.
